risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and identifies declines in revenue, operating income, operating cash flow, and free cash flow, alongside rising debt and substantial share repurchases. Risk is moderated by strong content ratings, diversified revenue sources, refinancing at lower rates, and detailed explanations of year-over-year comparability. Extensive non-GAAP framing and emphasis on adjusted or underlying performance may somewhat soften the presentation of weaker reported results.
